intro: Cherry splits your treatment into monthly payments, from $200 to $30,000. Approval does not affect your credit score.

steps.t: Apply on your phone before or after your estimate
Pick the monthly plan you prefer from the approved options
Cherry pays Xiluet directly. You pay Cherry monthly

faq.a: No. Cherry runs a soft check to pre-qualify you, which does not affect your score.
Cherry reports approving around 75 percent of applicants. If you are not approved, our coordinator helps you try another partner.

faq.q: Can I pay it off early?
faq.a: Yes. There is no penalty for paying off your plan early.

disclaimer: Cherry is a third-party lender. Financing is subject to credit approval. Terms and rates are set by Cherry and may change. Xiluet does not make credit decisions.
